lines.text: Exia.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: What is it?
Can you help me locate someone?

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: I'll need something to go on.
The name is Angelina. Female. Age 45.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: I'm more than happy to help,

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: but I must remind you...

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: We're operating well outside the boundaries of the law here.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: We can't make this a daily occurrence.
I won't, and thanks, Exia.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Hold on for a sec.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: I've got something.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Well, that's odd...
What is it?

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: She covers the same route every single day,

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: but she goes to seven different places.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: She only stays at her house for 4 hours a day.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: According to her file, she's unemployed, so she can't be working.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Something about this seems off to me.
Can you tell me more about those other locations?

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Sure, I'll send you a message.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Judging from her previous patterns, I can give you a rough estimate of her whereabouts.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Don't mention it.
